Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Coinbase: Derivative Sales Analyst
description: Headquarters: Remote - UK Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Derivative Sales Analyst on the Institutional team, you'll own and grow relationships with Coinbase's top VIP derivatives traders, driving volume across futures, options, and perpetuals. You'll source new high-value traders from competitor venues, re-engage dormant accounts, and bring structured market and client insights back to Product, Risk, and Marketing to shape Coinbase Advanced trading offerings. What you'll do: • Own and grow relationships with top VIP derivatives traders on Coinbase, driving increased trading volume, deepening engagement, and expanding adoption of advanced trading products. • Source and convert new high-value derivatives traders from competitor venues through targeted outbound campaigns, market positioning, and relationship-building. • Monitor derivatives market structure, client flows, and competitor offerings to identify upsell opportunities, inform pricing and product feedback, and deliver structured insights to Product, Risk, and Marketing. • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast for your book, reporting on key KPIs (volume, active traders, winbacks, competitor migration) and documenting client interactions through CRM tooling. • Reactivate previously dormant top traders using data-driven tools and bespoke incentives to restore sustained volume. • Build and refine AI-powered workflows for pipeline prioritization, client segmentation, and outreach personalization to scale coverage across your book. Required Skills and Experience: • 2+ years of sales or business development experience in financial services, trading, or crypto, with a track record of hitting or exceeding revenue and volume targets. • Demonstrated fluency in derivatives products (futures, options, perps) in traditional finance or crypto markets, evidenced by prior trading desk, brokerage, or exchange experience. • Data-driven operating style with experience using dashboards, CRMs, and basic analytics to segment books, identify opportunities, and prioritize outreach. • Background in business, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience working directly with trading clients. • Pre-existing network of active institutional derivatives traders you can bring to the platform on day one is preferred. • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary As a Matching Operations Coordinator, you will play a pivotal role in facilitating communication between talent and internal team members within our organization. Your primary focus will be to own and maintain effective communication channels with talent while managing various administrative tasks to ensure streamlined operations and job performance. We are seeking individuals who demonstrate exceptional organizational skills, confidence, and possess strong written and verbal communication abilities, with keen attention to detail. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. • Act as the primary point of contact for communication between talent who are hired on client engagements and internal Toptal stakeholders. • Independently manage communication through various channels to ensure seamless interactions and information sharing. Written communication is especially important. • Follow up with talent within assigned accounts to understand project status, identify and pursue up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, proactively prevent disputes, and share relevant updates with stakeholders as needed. • Manage and execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts to ensure smooth operations and job performance. • Maintain proactive and timely communication with the team via Slack or Zoom during designated working hours. • Organize and update process guidelines, making them easily accessible for team reference. • Assist in onboarding new team members to ensure a smooth integration process. • Support the completion of ad-hoc strategic projects, as needed. In the first week, expect to: • Complete onboarding and integration into Toptal. • Familiarize yourself with Toptal’s culture, history, and vision. • Learn team tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms. • Gain proficiency with Toptal’s platform. In the first month, expect to: • Understand team processes, policies, and content repository. • Familiarize yourself with various teams at Toptal and their contributions to company success. • Begin executing tasks with support from other team members. In the first three months, expect to: • Independently execute various tasks and actions associated with assigned accounts based on defined processes. In the first six months, expect to: • By having a full grasp of the role, start making your own contributions to our strategies, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. • Be an integral part of the Matching team’s success. In the first year, expect to: • Act as a subject matter expert on the Matching Operations Coordinator role. Qualifications and Job Requirements: • Bachelor’s degree is required. • 2-3+ years of experience in coordination, operations support, or customer support roles. • Excellent written and oral communication and stakeholder management skills. Good communication is at the core of everything we do. You must be able to maintain clear, timely, and smooth communication with talent and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment and preventing communication gaps or misunderstandings. • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. You are highly organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution. • You should be a self-starter who thrives on accountability and managing your own workflow, tasks, and assigned accounts. • Ability to work independently at a high professional level. You are expected to take ownership of your responsibilities, manage your workload effectively, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a high standard of professionalism with limited supervision. • You need to be able to follow processes expertly. When faced with limited data, you need to be able to make decisions that follow given guidelines. • Adaptability. Our processes and priorities may evolve rapidly. You need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly. • Willingness to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from teammates. • Proficiency in Google Sheets and Google Docs for data processing and presentation. • Data analysis and data-driven decision making. Experience analyzing operational data, identifying trends, and translating data into actionable insights is a plus. • Continuous Improvement. You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and use data and feedback to inform better ways of working. • Project management experience or technical background is advantageous. • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Technical Support Specialist (Hospitality), German speaking- all genders
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place.

Lightspeed is looking for a Technical Specialist, Strategic Accounts in Berlin. You will be mostly focused on K-Series, report into the Strategic Support Services Team Lead and will be an important part of our global hospitality support organization.

Our Strategic Support Services team oversees the Lightspeed Strategic Accounts support experience. This group partners with Senior Support + Strategic Accounts Management to quarterback the service experience for our most valuable and complex merchants.

What the Role involves

  • Deliver Premium Support: Provide exceptional technical assistance and white-glove customer service to Strategic Accounts via email, phone, video, and on-site engagements.

  • Optimize Business Processes: Proactively identify opportunities to recommend best practices, helping high-value clients streamline operations and maximize the value of the Lightspeed ecosystem.

  • Facilitate Seamless Transitions: Partner with Implementation teams to execute successful "warm handoffs," ensuring a consistent and smooth experience for new Strategic accounts.

  • Strengthen Account Partnerships: Collaborate closely with Strategic Account Managers (SAMs) to manage daily operations, resolve complex issues, and elevate the overall customer journey.

  • Anticipate Client Needs: Lead unified customer meetings alongside SAMs to review ongoing requests, forecast future requirements, and mitigate risks before they escalate.

  • Drive Features Adoption: Conduct proactive account health syncs (remote or on-site) to advocate for feature adoption that translates into measurable business growth for the client.

  • Provide Training Sessions: Ensure our Strategic customers continue to fully utilise the potential of our software by providing training to new and existing staff members.

  • Influence Product Strategy: Synthesize deep insights into client business challenges to advocate for product enhancements, liaising directly with Product and Development teams to refine the user experience.

  • Escalation Management: Manage high-stakes technical escalations end-to-end—overseeing technical resolution, executive communication, and stakeholder feedback loops to ensure total customer satisfaction.

  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Employ a comprehensive suite of diagnostic techniques to rapidly isolate the root cause of escalated issues and deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Knowledge Management: Maintain meticulous documentation of account-specific complexities and resolutions to empower global Support teams and ensure consistent service delivery.

  • Champion Technical Excellence: Write and maintain troubleshooting guides, testing procedures, and internal documentation while precisely tracking software defects for corrective action.

  • Cross-Platform Mastery: Continually develop technical expertise across all Strategic Lightspeed hospitality platforms to provide versatile, high-level support.

 

And a little bit of....

  • Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

Your experience

There’s many different ways to gain “experience”. People learn in different ways, skill sets can be transferred, especially when combined with a willingness to learn. If you don’t quite tick all of these boxes but think you could still absolutely smash it, send us an application anyway and let us know why you’d be amazing in this role!

  • This role is open to candidates located in Berlin.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English (we do service multiple languages, so any others you know are a bonus!).

  • Extensive customer service experience in a technical support role.

  • Prior experience in the Hospitality industry.

  • Ability to self-manage incoming emails, telephone calls, video calls, meetings, and on-site visits based on priority and customer commitments.

  • Strong computer skills and working knowledge of Mac OS.

  • Proven troubleshooting skills in a senior support position.

  • Strong problem-solving skills that will ensure our customers use their POS to its full capacity.

  • Ability to manage technical escalations of at-risk accounts and identify growth opportunities.

  • Flexibility in your schedule to work. Support never stops!

 

Even better if you have, but not necessary

  • Knowledge of networking or network support experience.

  • Understanding of API (relevant to SaaS) and experience supporting this.

  • Prior experience in a consultant role.

What’s in it for you

We're a global company, and our benefits vary depending on the country you live in. But here's a brief overview of our global benefits:

  • Equity options: We grant equity in the form of Restricted Share Units (RSUs) to our employees. Because this is your company, too.

  • Health & wellness credit: Our Health & Wellness credit can be used in numerous ways so that you feel at your best.

  • Career development: We're big on internal moves and new challenges across Lightspeed.

  • Time off to volunteer: Our volunteer program is a global initiative encouraging Lightspeeders to use one day off a year to give back to their communities.

  • Health apps: Access to professional or coaching services is available to all employees.

title: Better Proposals: Junior SEO Specialist
description: Headquarters: Brighton, UK URL: https://betterproposals.io/ Are you “the one”? We're looking for a Junior SEO Specialist to join our growth team. You’ll work directly with the Growth Manager and help with everything SEO related, from keyword research and internal linking to technical SEO, content planning and link building. This is a junior role, but not a trainee position. You should already understand the basics, know your way around the usual SEO tools and be ready to work on a real website. You will not be expected to know everything. You will be expected to learn as much as possible and figure things out. What does the job look like? The role covers most areas of SEO, including: • Researching keywords and identifying new opportunities • Reviewing existing pages and recommending improvements • Finding and implementing internal linking opportunities • Creating content briefs and proposing new pages • Monitoring rankings, traffic and organic conversions • Using Google Search Console to investigate performance and indexing • Crawling the website with Screaming Frog • Using Ahrefs for keyword, competitor, content and backlink research • Finding and qualifying link building prospects • Running outreach campaigns and following up with contacts • Tracking new links and reporting on campaign performance • Identifying common technical SEO issues • Creating and checking structured data • Improving page titles, descriptions, headings and on-page content • Helping us track GEO, AIO and AI search visibility You will not do every one of these things every day, and you will not be the only one on the team. Don’t have experience with all of these? Don’t worry. Some weeks will be more focused on content. Others might involve technical checks, outreach or improving pages that are already performing well. What we’re looking for You should already understand: • The basics of technical, on-page and off-page SEO • How to do keyword research • How to assess search intent • How internal linking works • The basics of link building and outreach • How to use Google Search Console • How to use the main reports in Ahrefs • How to crawl and inspect a website with Screaming Frog • What schema and structured data are • How to use AI tools to work faster without trusting everything they produce You do not need to be an expert in every area. We are looking for someone who understands the fundamentals, can follow a process and is willing to figure stuff out when they don’t immediately understand them. You should also be comfortable working independently. You will get direction and feedback and someone will always be there for you. But we are not interested in micro management. Nice to have It would be useful if you have experience with any of the following: • SaaS SEO • WordPress or another CMS • Basic HTML • Writing content briefs • Link building outreach • SEO reporting and analytics • GEO, AIO or optimisation for AI search tools Experience with GEO or AIO is welcome, but not required. Nobody has ten years of GEO experience. A genuine interest in learning about it is enough. Benefits • Salary dependent on experience and what you can bring to the role. We use Glassdoor as a guide for your location and pay above average. • Remote work in a global company, with a friendly and hardworking team • Opportunity to grow within the company, and earn promotions and pay rises • No work on your birthday • 3 weeks paid holiday + 1 week for every year (capped at 6 weeks) • Choose 8 national holidays that make sense to your country. • Annual bonus based on personal performance Our AI policy We don’t hate AI, but we NEVER use AI tools to produce customer facing content. Our customer support is not AI based, you always have a live person to talk to. Our articles are not AI written slop, but real opinions and expertise of real people. We want it to stay that way. Using AI tools for keyword research, data analytics and process improvements is cool. Posting what ChatGPT spits out and passing it as a blog article is a fireable offence! Next steps Assuming everything goes well, here’s how our hiring process goes: • You apply • We have an initial interview • We will have a 2nd interview • In special cases we might have a quick 3rd call to clarify a few things, but mostly not. • We offer you the job • You’re expected to accept it within 1 business day.
